name: GoatCounter
license: EUPL-1.2 (modified Compatible Licenses appendix; GitHub reports NOASSERTION)
param_style: zdb: :name parameters and {{:cond ...}} template sections, sent to SQLite as positional ? (slices expanded); :filter inlined as SQL text; here each distinct name is one ?N
schema_source: db/schema.gotxt rendered for SQLite with zdb's template functions; only the tables and indexes the queries need
data_scale: scale 1: 1 busy site + 1 small, 20.4k paths (power-law x^5 popularity, 60% under /blog/), 3k refs, 150 browsers, 60 systems, 50 locations, 200k hits over 180 days, rolled up exactly like the cron: ~108k hit_counts, ~113k ref_counts, ~105-113k rows in each daily *_stats table, 12k filter_paths for one saved search; ~106 MB
visibility_note: 6.1k stars; runs goatcounter.com; SQLite is a first-class backend for self-hosting
interest_note: Dashboard widgets are GROUP BY/SUM over hourly and daily rollup tables with CTE top-N then join, json_group_object time series, timezone-shifted text keys, LIKE path search feeding IN-lists or a filter_paths subquery, multi-row upserts adding to counters.
reach_note: widely self-hosted plus the hosted goatcounter.com (PostgreSQL there); SQLite is the default for self-hosting

cpu_evidence.summary: Dashboard path filters: path_id in (up to ~1M ids) spent minutes in planning; SQLite also caps variables at 32,766, so >10k matches now go through the filters/filter_paths tables
Dashboard widgets (Systems, referrers, browsers) timing out on goatcounter.com after a performance change was rolled back during an influx of accounts
